title: Business Advisor - CISBDC
description:
Position Overview

The Business Advisor at the Indiana Small Business Development
Center (ISBDC) is a dynamic role focused on providing direct
support and counsel to small businesses within an eight-county
region, including the Indianapolis metropolitan area. The Business
Advisor will be responsible for advising and guiding small
businesses in various stages of development, conducting training
sessions, and tracking client progress using the Neoserra Client
Management System (CMS). This role demands compliance with both
federal Small Business Administration (SBA) standards and the
standards set by the State of Indiana Economic Development
Corporation, host of the ISBDC network.

Responsibilities

Client Counselling

Provide one-on-one counselling to entrepreneurs and small
business owners on a range of topics, including business planning,
financing, marketing, management, and operations.

Training Programs

Develop and deliver training programs for local small
businesses on key business topics, equipping entrepreneurs with the
skills and knowledge they need to succeed.

Client Management

Track client progress using the Neoserra CMS, ensuring all data
is accurate and up-to-date. Ensure client interactions meet SBA
counselling standards.

Performance Metrics

Meet performance metrics set by the SBA and the State of
Indiana Economic Development Corporation. Regularly report on
performance and client outcomes.

Stakeholder Engagement

Collaborate with the Regional Director and Deputy Regional
Director to engage with local business leaders, community
organizations, government entities, and academic institutions.

Community Involvement

Participate in community events and public forums to promote
the ISBDC and its services to the local business community.

Continuous Learning

Stay informed about trends and developments in small business,
economic development, and other relevant areas. Continually improve
counselling and training services based on current best
practices.

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree plus a minimum of two years of relevant
professional experience in business advising, consulting, economic
development, business operations, entrepreneurship, or a related
field.
Demonstrated ability to advise, support, or work
collaboratively with business owners, entrepreneurs, clients, or
other external stakeholders.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the
ability to present information and facilitate training or
educational sessions.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage
multiple clients, projects, priorities, and deadlines while
maintaining accurate documentation.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability
to learn and effectively utilize client relationship management
(CRM/CMS) systems.
Ability to work occasional evenings and weekends to support
community events, training programs, and other business-related
activities.

Relevant Obligations

As a member of the ISBDC, the Business Advisor has obligations to
uphold transparency, meet compliance requirements set by the SBA
and the State of Indiana Economic Development Corporation, and
ensure equitable access to ISBDC services for all clients.

The Business Advisor role requires a strong understanding of small
business development, excellent communication skills, and the
ability to connect with diverse stakeholders. The Business Advisor
must be a dedicated advocate for small businesses and economic
development in the region, ready to support entrepreneurs at all
stages of their business journey.

About Us

Butler University is a private, nationally recognized comprehensive
university encompassing seven colleges: Arts, Business,
Communication, Education, Liberal Arts & Sciences, Pharmacy
& Health Sciences and Founder's College. Approximately 4,500
undergraduate and 1,000 graduate and doctoral students are enrolled
at Butler, representing 46 states and 24 countries.

Join us at the crossroads of tradition & transformation. A
career at Butler University offers more than just a job—it’s an
opportunity to join a dedicated, innovative, and supportive
community grounded in equity, academic excellence, and meaningful
impact. Aligned with Boldly Butler, our strategic plan, faculty and
staff play a vital role in delivering transformational learning
experiences, enriching our campus and community, and ensuring a
thriving Butler for generations to come.

Butler University is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome
applications from all individuals, regardless of age, sex, race,
religion, color, disability, protected veteran status, national
origin, or any other legally protected category.
